features.title: Arrange plugin panels in independent layouts
features.summary: Opens on the Editor alone, then adds panels and arranges tab, split, float, move, close, and reset operations independently in the main workbench and right-side pane. The Scratchpad and Ticker docking fixtures appear only behind a developer setting.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the workbench header toggle.
Boolean; offer the Scratchpad and Ticker developer fixtures in Add panel.

failureModes: Malformed persisted layout falls back to defaults.
An unavailable registered plugin remains a closable placeholder and recovers when it registers.

verification.testName: opens the Editor alone by default and leaves the other panels to Add panel
opens the first two registered panels side by side by default
restores the saved layout after a reload
keeps a saved panel whose plugin is gone as a closable placeholder that recovers on registration
falls back to the default layout when Dockview rejects the saved one
keeps the side-panel layout apart from the main-area one

features.title: Keep one docking surface in the right column across threads
features.summary: With the right column set to the global dock, the workbench renders its Dockview in the frame's own right-column seat instead of a session's right sidebar, so the same panel set and layout serve every thread and survive a reload. Jujutsu marks itself as the dock's default panel, and the native per-thread surface stays one setting away.

configuration.constraints: One of native or dock; applies live and chooses which surface fills the frame's right column.

failureModes: On a frame without the seat the registration is inert and the setting changes nothing.
A saved dock layout that Dockview rejects falls back to the dock's default panel.
While the on-screen Session has a native tab open, the column goes back to the native surface so the resource stays visible.

externalDependencies.boundary: The frame owns the right column and renders the shell.dock seat; the workbench contributes the surface there and reports the mode through ctx.rightPanel.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Unit tests render WorkbenchView with the dock surface over memory storage; the scratch journey boots the isolated composition of frame-layout, workbench and jujutsu.

verification.testName: leads the dock default layout with the dock panel, and the main one with the Editor
keeps the global dock layout apart from the main-area and side-panel ones
gives the column back to the native surface while the on-screen session has an open tab

features.title: Queue panel-open requests before mount
features.summary: Retain stable panel registrations and early open requests until the matching dock view mounts.
failureModes: A duplicate or missing panel identity cannot silently replace another registration.

verification.testName: keeps open requests, deduplicated and latest last, until the workbench takes them
opens a panel another plugin asks for, even when asked before the view mounted
shares one page-wide instance across bundles through a global symbol
